title: 分析师：Jirupu新模型未达预期，市场用脚投票
speaker: Anthony Stephens

segments.en: Yeah, so the first part of the Jirupu model thing is it doesn't really move the needle in terms of what it can do on the software side as much as investors had hoped.
segments.zh: Jirupu新模型在软件能力上并未带来显著提升，未达市场预期。

segments.en: So, they've made it much more about cybersecurity, which is important, fair, right? But that's not what people are paying up for in Jirupu.
segments.zh: 他们把重点转向网络安全，这固然重要，但并非市场对Jirupu的核心期待。

segments.en: They're paying up a better coding performance, right? And they have to close that gap with Fable 5, with cursor and all the rest of it, right?
segments.zh: 市场期待的是更强的代码能力，他们需要缩小与Fable 5、Cursor等产品的差距。

segments.en: And that gap has not closed materially. In the meantime, you see other Chinese competitors start to close that gap.
segments.zh: 但差距并未实质缩小，与此同时，其他国内竞争对手正在迎头赶上。

segments.en: So, like, for example, Moonshire, or the Deepseek new model on the flash side. So, there's this accelerated sense of progress where the bar has now moved higher.
segments.zh: 例如Moonshire、DeepSeek的新模型等，行业进步加速，门槛已抬高。

segments.en: You cannot just have a bunch more parameters or a new capability and then the market celebrates. It has to be materially better than the Chinese players you're competing against, right?
segments.zh: 仅靠增加参数或新功能已无法赢得市场，必须显著优于国内同行。

segments.en: So, that dynamic now becomes much harsher into the back end of the year. Everybody knows the Chinese are good, as Rob said now, right?
segments.zh: 这一竞争态势在年底将更加激烈，众所周知，国内厂商实力不俗。

segments.en: So, who is the best becomes the toughest question? And that's a very tough question for Jirupu, as it sits on the absolute top of the stock market performance league in the market.
segments.zh: 谁是最强者成为最难回答的问题，对Jirupu而言尤为棘手，因其股价表现位居市场前列。

segments.en: And on the company itself, you don't think that there's actually the company can capitalize specifically on this new model.
segments.zh: 而且，你认为公司本身未必能凭借这款新模型获得优势。
